messages:
anya: quick thread  proposing a "mini" action variant for dense tables (visual 28px) to reduce vertical rhythm. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/mini-actions. issues: icon baseline looks off, focus ring clips, and success toasts feel too brief on slow networks. thoughts?

mike: prefer no explicit height. keep visual 28px but add invisible hit padding to reach 44px. wrapper approach works. avoid translateY on svgs.

lee: agree on wrapper. for focus clipping either move actions outside overflow:hidden or use outline-offset token. moving is safer for shadows.

harper: toast durations should be tokens. suggestion: short=1400ms, med=2400ms, long=3600ms. also ensure toasts are aria-live=polite and not focusable so they don't steal focus.

anya: will update Figma, add hit-wrapper pattern, remove svg transforms, center icons with inline-flex, and add toast tokens + i18n copy changes ("Run evaluation"). will open a small PR with visual diffs.

design-bot: created tokens: spacing.compact=6px, touch.hitPadding=8px, toast.duration.medium=2400ms, focus.outlineOffset=3px. PR: #710.
